∀ (k : Type u) [inst : Field.{u} k] (V : Type v) [inst_1 : AddCommGroup.{v} V] [inst_2 : Module.{u, v} k V]
  [Module.Finite.{u, v} k V] (n : Nat) [IsAlgClosed.{u} k] [CharZero.{u} k],
  Exists.{2} fun ι =>
    Exists.{1} fun x =>
      Exists.{1} fun x =>
        Exists.{max (u + 2) (v + 2)} fun S =>
          Exists.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)} fun x =>
            Exists.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)} fun x_1 =>
              Exists.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)} fun x_2 =>
                Exists.{0} fun x_3 =>
                  Exists.{0} fun x_4 =>
                    Exists.{0} fun x_5 =>
                      Exists.{0} fun x_6 =>
                        Exists.{max (u + 2) (v + 2)} fun L =>
                          Exists.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)} fun x_7 =>
                            Exists.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)} fun x_8 =>
                              Exists.{max (u + 1) (v + 1)} fun x_9 =>
                                Exists.{0} fun x_10 =>
                                  And
                                    (∀ (i j : ι),
                                      Nonempty.{(max u v) + 1}
                                          (LinearEquiv.{max u v, max u v, max u v, max u v}
                                            (RingHom.id.{max u v}
                                              (Subtype.{(max u v) + 1} fun x =>
                                                Membership.mem.{max u v, max u v}
                                                  (Etingof.diagonalActionImage.{u, v} k V n) x))
                                            (L i) (L j)) →
                                        Eq.{1} i j)
                                    (Nonempty.{max ((max u v) + 1) ((max v u) + 1)}
                                      (LinearEquiv.{u, u, max v u, max u v} (RingHom.id.{u} k)
                                        (Etingof.TensorPower.{u, v} k V n)
                                        (DirectSum.{0, max u v} ι fun i =>
                                          TensorProduct.{u, max u v, max u v} k (S i) (L i))))

source_text: The tensor power has a decomposition into simple, pairwise distinct left factors and simple, pairwise distinct multiplicity factors, equivariant for both actions.
